title: PlasmaZones Layout
description: A tiling layout with identity metadata and a list of zones with relative geometry. Structural invariants are enforced here. The optional appearance, gap, geometry-mode, and visibility keys are allowed through so editor-produced and future layouts are not rejected.

id.description: Stable layout identity, a UUID with or without braces. Built-in layouts use a brace-wrapped one. The loader gives a layout whose id is not a UUID, or is the nil UUID, a new random one on every load, so anything keyed by its id does not stick.

name.description: Display name. The loader rejects layouts with an empty name.

type.description: Legacy layout-type key. The loader ignores it, so the schema accepts any value.

isSystem.description: Legacy key. The loader ignores it and decides from the directory a layout was loaded from, so the schema accepts any value.

fixedGeometryInDevicePixels.description: When true, the fixedGeometry of every fixed-mode zone counts the output's device pixels and is divided by the output's scale when resolved. Omitting the key means logical pixels.

aspectRatioClass.description: Aspect-ratio bucket the layout targets. Both serialized forms are on the wire, and readers accept either. Layout::toJson emits the canonical string, while the editor's save round-trip carries the raw enum int. Omitting the key means Any.

zones.description: At least one zone. The loader rejects zero-zone layouts.

relativeGeometry.description: Screen-relative rectangle in the range 0.0-1.0. Width and height must be positive.
